items.title: Earnings live: Amazon stock surges on earnings beat, Apple stock slides
items.summary: Earnings season kicks into high gear this week.

items.title: Vertiv CEO: How Google, Meta, Microsoft earnings are 'reinforcing' data center acceleration
items.summary: Vertiv (VRT) stock is rebounding after the company reported quarterly earnings. Vertiv CEO Giordano "Gio" Albertazzi sits down with Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman to discuss Vertiv's demand from AI hyperscalers, data center backlash, and more.

items.title: Microsoft stock surges on earnings: A closer look at Copilot, Azure, and capex
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) stock is jumping after the company reported surging cloud growth. Morning Brief host Julie Hyman chats with Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley about the results.

items.title: Banks in Talks to Lend $15 Billion for Anthropic Data Center Backed by Google
items.summary: Google’s guarantees of power and lease obligations would help the developer secure financing for the 1.6-gigawatt Texas project.

items.title: Everyone Wants to Build the Best AI Model. Amazon Wants Something More Valuable.
items.summary: Everyone is debating which AI company will build the best AI model. But that may be the wrong question for investors to focus on.

items.title: Amazon Shares Jump as Cloud Sales—and Spending—Accelerate
items.summary: The company raised its capital spending forecast and said Amazon Web Services sales increased 37% in the second quarter.

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq End Best Day In A Month On Support From Microsoft Gains, AI Stocks  — ORCL, GOOGL, MSFT, BE, TSLA Stock In Focus
items.summary: Microsoft stock records best day since 2008 on strong cloud revenue.

items.title: Microsoft’s One-Day Market-Cap Gain Makes History
items.summary: Plus, banks are in talks to lend $15 billion for a Google-backed Anthropic data center, and Spider-Man’s youngest fans might help make the new movie a hit.
